base.note: calm breathing, longest near-still span; forward loop 120->90

glanceLeft.note: glance toward viewer-left (her right), back to ready at 41

glanceRight.note: glance toward viewer-right (her left) with a blink, back to ready at 90

measured.method: phase correlation of the head crop against frame 0 (dx px) plus mean abs grey difference; motion/head-motion.json, head-motion.png, head-sheet.jpg
measured.observed: frames 0-5 ready; 6-40 head turns toward viewer-LEFT (her right, dx to -31 px at 23-28) and returns by 41; 42-89 head turns toward viewer-RIGHT (her left, dx to +30 px at 54-64) and returns by 90; 90-120 calm breathing, dx under 0.4 px. The README order (left first) is by viewer direction; the hands settle 1.4 px after frame 5 and stay.

note: Waiting idle for the Blender table; plays segment by segment under a randomized scheduler; any dealing take holds it at the running segment end (ready pose).
